pitch:
ILLUSTRUS (Oradea / Bucharest) delivers, under your agency's brand, the parts of grant-funded projects your team doesn't build: integrations and funded-project pages.

Menu, fixed prices to you (excl. VAT): contact form → CRM + notification 150 EUR; WhatsApp document-collection link with reminders 400 EUR; page auto-fed from an official source (JSON/RSS, e.g. open funding calls) 250 EUR; reporting dashboard for a funded project 600 EUR; the funding-visibility page in the programme's required format 120 EUR. You bill your client whatever you like (automation agencies in Romania charge 300–1,500 EUR for similar work).

How it works: written scope and deadline per task (5–10 working days), acceptance checklist, NDA, your client never sees my name. Reply within 24 hours on working days. Two unavailable weeks a year (mid-January, mid-June, university exams) announced a month ahead. First task: 50% advance; after that, pay on delivery. For a new agency, the first small task (up to 10 hours) is free, so you see the work before you pay anything.

Who I am: a database and integrations developer (Oracle APEX / PL/SQL by day, n8n, Python, WordPress), owner of a grant-funded firm, so I know what funded projects require in paperwork and visibility. One person, 10–12 hours a week on this, so I take at most two agency tasks at a time.

What this is not: not hourly staff augmentation, not phone support during your business hours, not design work.
